g.text: Balanced inputs. A TS plug grounds the ring, so unbalanced sources need no switch.

g.desc: Balanced inputs. A TS plug grounds the ring, so unbalanced sources need no switch.

g.text: THAT 1246 = -6 dB, so +22 dBu peak (9.75 Vrms) becomes 4.9 Vrms, inside the PGA2310 9.5 Vrms full scale.

g.desc: THAT 1246 = -6 dB, so +22 dBu peak (9.75 Vrms) becomes 4.9 Vrms, inside the PGA2310 9.5 Vrms full scale.

g.text: 100 pF C0G on every tip and ring shunts RF to ground. Tip-normal grounded: an empty input is silent, not noisy.

g.desc: 100 pF C0G on every tip and ring shunts RF to ground. Tip-normal grounded: an empty input is silent, not noisy.

g.text: Bypass, one per supply pin, within 5 mm of U1 / U2. C40, C41 bulk for the input side.

g.desc: Bypass, one per supply pin, within 5 mm of U1 / U2. C40, C41 bulk for the input side.

g.text: J1 ring-normal contact: shorted to the ring (and so to U1 In-) with no plug,

g.desc: J1 ring-normal contact: shorted to the ring (and so to U1 In-) with no plug,

g.text: open with any plug. Reads low when empty, high with TS or TRS plugged in.

g.desc: open with any plug. Reads low when empty, high with TS or TRS plugged in.
